intended_behavior_phases: Phase 1: Stabilize and descend toward pad vicinity using main engine and orientation corrections.
Phase 2: Fine-tune horizontal position and vertical velocity for soft landing on pad.
Phase 3: Touch down with both legs on pad, zero velocity, upright orientation.

component_scale_reasoning.objective_success_bonus: Large positive reward (+100) for successful landing (both legs on ground, near pad, low velocity) to strongly incentivize task completion.
component_scale_reasoning.crash_penalty: Large negative reward (-100) for crash or out-of-bounds to discourage failure.
component_scale_reasoning.distance_shaping: Moderate shaping (-10 * distance_to_pad) to provide dense progress feedback toward the pad.
component_scale_reasoning.velocity_regularizer: Mild penalty (-0.1 * |vertical_velocity|) to encourage soft landing without discouraging necessary descent.
component_scale_reasoning.angle_regularizer: Mild penalty (-0.05 * |angle|) to encourage upright posture.
component_scale_reasoning.fuel_penalty: Very mild penalty (-0.01 * (m_power + s_power)) to discourage excessive fuel use without hindering necessary engine firings.
component_scale_reasoning.hovering_penalty: Small penalty (-0.1) when hovering (low speed, no ground contact) to discourage indefinite hovering.
